simple.summary: אֲחֻזַּת (ʼĂchuzzath) means Achuzzath , a Philistine First listed occurrence: Gen 26 26.

definitions.full: H276. Achuzzath אֲחֻזַּת proper name, masculine ( possession ) friend of Abi-melech Gen 26:26 . I. אחח ( cry, howl , onomatopoetic, compare Arabic ).
